bookSourceComment:
绅士漫画官方直连书源
1. 线路切换：支持在“源登录”界面一键打开发布页(wnacg01.link/wnacg02.link)，提供预设官方镜像线路下拉切换与自定义域名输入，支持测速延迟、一键保存生效
2. 丰富发现：涵盖同人志、单行本、短篇、韩漫、CG画集、3D漫画、Cosplay、AI图集与多维度排行榜
3. 智能分类：原生提取分类、页数/话数、状态、汉化组、车牌号及全量作品Tags
4. 深度评论：自动点开评论原页面抓取一级书友评论与二级多层回复 (replies)
5. 完美排版：车牌号、收录容量、作品分类与分段叙述层级分明
6. 目录自适应：全一话短篇自动适配，多章节合集智能翻页获取全部章节
7. 极速画质：直连官方图片分发节点，支持高清WebP/JPG流畅阅读
7. 搜索筛选：搜索框输入 `关键词|cate=9`、`关键词|tag=巨乳`、`关键词|sort=month` 可套用原站筛选；支持 cate/xcate/tag/xtag/u/xu/sort，多个条件用 | 分隔

<js>
function getActiveDomain() {
    var domain = "";
    if (typeof result !== 'undefined' && result) {
        var custom = (result.get ? result.get("自定义域名") : result["自定义域名"]);
        if (custom && String(custom).trim()) {
            domain = String(custom).trim();
        } else {
            var preset = (result.get ? result.get("预设线路") : result["预设线路"]);
            if (preset && String(preset).trim()) domain = String(preset).trim();
        }
    }
    if (!domain) {
        if (typeof getDomain === 'function') domain = getDomain();
        else domain = "https://www.wnacg.com";
    }
    domain = String(domain).trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(domain)) {
        domain = "https://" + domain;
    }
    return domain;
}

function openPublish(url) {
    if (typeof java !== 'undefined') {
        if (typeof java.startBrowser === 'function') {
            java.startBrowser(url, "官方发布页");
        } else if (typeof java.showBrowser === 'function') {
            java.showBrowser(url);
        }
    }
}

function applyPreset() {
    var p = "";
    if (typeof result !== 'undefined' && result) {
        p = (result.get ? result.get("预设线路") : result["预设线路"]) || "";
    }
    if (!p) p = "https://www.wnacg.com";
    if (typeof java !== 'undefined') {
        if (typeof java.upLoginData === 'function') {
            try {
                var m = new java.util.HashMap();
                m.put("自定义域名", p);
                java.upLoginData(m);
            } catch(e) {
                java.upLoginData({"自定义域名": p});
            }
        }
        if (typeof java.toast === 'function') {
            java.toast("已填入预设线路:\n" + p);
        }
    }
}

function testDomain() {
    var domain = getActiveDomain();
    if (typeof java !== 'undefined' && typeof java.ajax === 'function') {
        if (typeof java.toast === 'function') {
            java.toast("正在测试连接: " + domain + " ...");
        }
        try {
            var t0 = new Date().getTime();
            var res = java.ajax(domain + "/search/?q=test");
            var t1 = new Date().getTime();
            if (res && (res.indexOf("gallary") !== -1 || res.indexOf("html") !== -1 || res.indexOf("wnacg") !== -1)) {
                if (typeof java.toast === 'function') {
                    java.toast("连接成功！响应延迟: " + (t1 - t0) + "ms\n" + domain);
                }
            } else {
                if (typeof java.toast === 'function') {
                    java.toast("响应异常，建议更换其他镜像线路");
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {
            if (typeof java.toast === 'function') {
                java.toast("连接失败: " + e.message + "\n请更换发布页提供的最新域名");
            }
        }
    }
}

function saveDomain() {
    var domain = getActiveDomain();
    var s = (typeof source !== 'undefined' && source) ? source : (this && this.source ? this.source : null);
    if (s && typeof s.putLoginInfo === 'function') {
        var saveObj = {
            "预设线路": domain,
            "自定义域名": domain
        };
        try {
            s.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(saveObj));
        } catch(e) {}
    }
    if (typeof java !== 'undefined') {
        if (typeof java.refreshExplore === 'function') {
            java.refreshExplore();
        }
        if (typeof java.toast === 'function') {
            java.toast("域名设置成功并已生效:\n" + domain);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

function login() {
    return saveDomain();
}
</js>

<js>
result = (function() {
    var raw = (result ? result.toString() : (src ? src.toString() : ""));
    var aidMatch = baseUrl.match(/aid-(\d+)/);
    var aid = aidMatch ? aidMatch[1] : "";

    var trainNo = aid ? ("wnacg" + aid) : "";
    var mSize = raw.match(/(?:頁數|章節)[:：]\s*([^<]+)/) || raw.match(/<span class="date"[^>]*>\s*([^<]+)\s*<\/span>/i);
    var size = mSize ? mSize[1].trim() : "";
    var mCat = raw.match(/分類[:：]\s*([^<]+)/) || raw.match(/href="\/albums-index-cate-\d+\.html"[^>]*>\s*([^<]+?)\s*<\/a>/i) || raw.match(/<span class="pd">([^<]*[／\/][^<]*)<\/span>/i);
    var cat = mCat ? mCat[1].trim() : "";

    var desc = "";
    var mDesc = raw.match(/<p[^>]*>\s*簡介[:：]([\s\S]*?)<\/p>/i) || raw.match(/<div class="dv-desc-text"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/div>/i);
    if (mDesc) {
        desc = mDesc[1].replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, "\n").replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").trim();
    }

    var headerLine = [];
    if (trainNo) headerLine.push("🆔【车牌号码】 " + trainNo);
    if (size) headerLine.push("📚【收录容量】 " + size);
    if (cat) headerLine.push("🏷️【作品分类】 " + cat);
    var parts = [];
    if (headerLine.length > 0) parts.push(headerLine.join("      "));

    if (desc) {
        parts.push("📖【作品叙述】\n" + desc);
    } else {
        parts.push("📖【作品叙述】\n暂无作品叙述。");
    }

    var comments = [];
    if (aid && typeof java !== 'undefined' && typeof java.ajax === 'function') {
        try {
            var domain = (baseUrl && baseUrl.match(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/i)) ? baseUrl.match(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/i)[0] : getDomain();
            var commentUrl = domain + "/comment-index-aid-" + aid + ".html";
            var cHtml = java.ajax(commentUrl);
            if (cHtml && cHtml.indexOf("plItem") !== -1) {
                var partsSplit = cHtml.split('<div class="plItem"');
                for (var i = 1; i < partsSplit.length && comments.length < 20; i++) {
                    var p = partsSplit[i];
                    var mName = p.match(/class="plName">([^<]+)<\/span>/);
                    var mTime = p.match(/class="plTime">([^<]+)<\/span>/);
                    var mText = p.match(/class="plText">([\s\S]*?)<\/div>/);
                    var mUp = p.match(/class="plUp"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<i>(\d+)<\/i>/);
                    var uName = mName ? mName[1].trim() : "书友";
                    var uTime = mTime ? mTime[1].trim() : "";
                    var uText = mText ? mText[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").trim() : "";
                    var uUp = (mUp && mUp[1] !== "0") ? (" 👍🏻" + mUp[1]) : "";
                    if (uText) {
                        var tStr = uTime ? ("[" + uTime + "]") : "";
                        var cBlock = tStr + "\n👤 【" + uName + "】" + uUp + "：\n" + uText;
                        var rSplit = p.split('<div class="plRe"');
                        for (var j = 1; j < rSplit.length && j <= 5; j++) {
                            var rp = rSplit[j];
                            var mrName = rp.match(/class="plName">([^<]+)<\/span>/);
                            var mrTo = rp.match(/class="plReTo">([^<]+)<\/span>/);
                            var mrTime = rp.match(/class="plTime">([^<]+)<\/span>/);
                            var mrText = rp.match(/class="plText">([\s\S]*?)<\/div>/);
                            var mrUp = rp.match(/class="plUp"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<i>(\d+)<\/i>/);
                            var ruName = mrName ? mrName[1].trim() : "书友";
                            var ruTo = mrTo ? (" " + mrTo[1].trim()) : "";
                            var ruTime = mrTime ? ("[" + mrTime[1].trim() + "]") : "";
                            var ruText = mrText ? mrText[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").trim() : "";
                            var ruUp = (mrUp && mrUp[1] !== "0") ? (" 👍🏻" + mrUp[1]) : "";
                            if (ruText) {
                                cBlock += "\nㅤ    ↳ " + ruTime + " 【" + ruName + "】" + ruTo + ruUp + "：\nㅤ      " + ruText;
                            }
                        }
                        comments.push(cBlock);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch(err) {}
    }

    if (comments.length > 0) {
        parts.push("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n☕【书友评论 (" + comments.length + "条)】\n\n" + comments.join("\n\n"));
    } else {
        parts.push("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n☕【书友评论】\n暂无书友评论。");
    }

    return parts.join("\n\n");
})();
result;
</js>

result = (function() {
    var tags = [];
    var addTag = function(t) {
        if (!t) return;
        t = String(t).trim();
        if (t && t.length < 30 && tags.indexOf(t) === -1 && !t.startsWith('+')) {
            tags.push(t);
        }
    };
    var raw = (result ? result.toString() : (src ? src.toString() : ""));

    var mCat = raw.match(/分類[:：]\s*([^<]+)/) || raw.match(/href="\/albums-index-cate-\d+\.html"[^>]*>\s*([^<]+?)\s*<\/a>/i) || raw.match(/<span class="pd">([^<]*[／\/][^<]*)<\/span>/i);
    if (mCat) {
        var cats = mCat[1].trim().split(/[/／]/);
        for (var c = 0; c < cats.length; c++) addTag(cats[c]);
    }

    var mSize = raw.match(/(?:頁數|章節)[:：]\s*([^<]+)/) || raw.match(/<span class="date"[^>]*>\s*([^<]+)\s*<\/span>/i);
    if (mSize) addTag(mSize[1].trim());

    var mStatus = raw.match(/狀態[:：]\s*([^<]+)/) || raw.match(/class="sr_stag[^"]*"[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/span>/i);
    if (mStatus) addTag(mStatus[1].trim());

    var mTags = raw.match(/class="(?:tagshow|dv-tag)"[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/a>/g);
    if (mTags) {
        for (var i = 0; i < mTags.length; i++) {
            var tName = mTags[i].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").trim();
            addTag(tName);
        }
    }

    var mTitle = raw.match(/<h2[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h2>/i) || raw.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
    if (mTitle) {
        var titleText = mTitle[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").trim();
        var mTeam = titleText.match(/\[([^\[\]]*?(?:漢化|汉化|組|组|個人|译|翻譯|翻译)[^\[\]]*?)\]\s*$/);
        if (mTeam) addTag(mTeam[1]);
    }

    var aidMatch = baseUrl.match(/aid-(\d+)/);
    if (aidMatch) addTag("wnacg" + aidMatch[1]);

    return tags.join(",");
})();
result;
</js>

var domain = "";
try {
  var s = (typeof source !== 'undefined' && source) ? source : null;
  if (s && typeof s.getLoginInfoMap === 'function') {
    var info = s.getLoginInfoMap();
    if (info) {
      var custom = (info.get ? info.get("自定义域名") : null) || info["自定义域名"];
      if (custom && String(custom).trim()) domain = String(custom).trim();
    }
  }
} catch(e) {}
if (!domain && typeof getDomain === 'function') {
  try { domain = getDomain(); } catch(e) {}
}
if (!domain) {
  try {
    var b = (typeof baseUrl !== 'undefined' && baseUrl) ? String(baseUrl) : "";
    var m = b.match(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/i);
    if (m) domain = m[0];
  } catch(e) {}
}
if (!domain) domain = "https://www.wnacg.com";
domain = String(domain).trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(domain)) domain = "https://" + domain;

// 关键词可追加筛选：关键词|cate=9|tag=巨乳|sort=month
var raw = String(typeof key !== 'undefined' && key ? key : "").trim();
var parts = raw.split("|");
var q = (parts.shift() || "").trim();
var sortMap = {latest:"create_time_DESC", day:"heat_day_DESC", week:"heat_week_DESC", month:"heat_month_DESC", year:"heat_year_DESC"};
var url = domain + "/search/index.php?q=" + encodeURIComponent(q) + "&m=&syn=yes&f=_all&s=create_time_DESC";
for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
  var p = String(parts[i] || "").trim();
  if (!p) continue;
  var idx = p.indexOf("=");
  if (idx < 0) continue;
  var k = p.substring(0, idx).trim();
  var v = p.substring(idx + 1).trim();
  if (!v) continue;
  if (k === "sort") {
    url += "&s=" + encodeURIComponent(sortMap[v] || v);
  } else if (k === "cate" || k === "xcate" || k === "tag" || k === "xtag" || k === "u" || k === "xu") {
    url += "&" + k + "=" + encodeURIComponent(v);
  }
}
var pg = (typeof page !== 'undefined' && page) ? page : "{{page}}";
url += "&p=" + pg;
result = url;
